title: The Flamingo Lake
text: A salt lake pink with flamingos, thousands upon thousands of them, standing on one leg in the shallows. Their honking fills the air. The water is bitter and no fish live in it, but the shore is crusted thick with white salt.

options.label: Gather the white salt, and ignore the honking.

outcomes.text: The salt is good and sells well. The flamingos never stop honking.

options.label: Rest by the water and watch them. You may never see anything this peaceful again.

outcomes.text: You pass an afternoon of pink and quiet. For once nothing is wrong, which is almost more than you can bear.

options.label: The quickest wades out for a feather, for luck.

outcomes.text: They bring back a long pink feather, for luck.
The flock rises all at once in a roar of wings. The salt crust underfoot cuts like glass.
